atlas_violencia.name: Atlas da Violência — séries de homicídios (all series whose title contains 'Homicídio')
atlas_violencia.publisher: Instituto de Pesquisa Econômica Aplicada (IPEA) with Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública; underlying data MS/SVSA Sistema de Informações sobre Mortalidade (SIM/DATASUS)
atlas_violencia.years: Registered homicides and rate: municipality and state 2000-2024; macro-region from 1979/1989; capitals 1989-2022; sex/race/youth/firearm series only at macro-region and state-capital level, mostly 1989 or 1996 to 2022/2023
atlas_violencia.notes: Values as returned by the Atlas data API (the data behind the site's series pages). Measure = Atlas series title in Portuguese ('Homicídios registrados' = registered homicides from SIM; 'Taxa de ...' = rate per 100,000; 'Jovens' = youth; 'Negros/Não Negros' = Black/non-Black; 'Homens/Mulheres' = men/women; 'por Armas de Fogo' = by firearm). Series 95 is a percentage (undetermined-intent violent deaths relative to homicides). Hidden/estimated homicide series (365-368) exist only nationally, so no rows. Breakdowns are separate series in the source, so breakdown='Total'. Municipal codes from the API are 6-digit IBGE codes; converted to 7-digit IBGE codes and names with the IBGE localidades API (raw/ibge_localidades_*.json). State capitals appear as 'municipality' (series 20/328) and as 'municipality (state capital)' (other series). Macro-regions have no shape.

problems: geoBoundaries BRA ADM2 has names only (no IBGE codes). Matched by name within state (state via ISO code BR-XX; geoBoundaries ADM1 names have typos like 'Rio de Jeneiro'). About 65 border municipalities whose simplified shape fell in the neighbouring state were matched by a nationally unique name; 3 same-name pairs on state borders (Santa Cruz RN/PB, Várzea RN/PB, Quixaba PB/PE) assigned by distance to the correct state; 6 spelling variants matched by hand (São Luiz do Anauá=São Luiz, Assú=Açu, Arez=Arês, Graccho Cardoso=Gracho Cardoso, Barão do Monte Alto=Barão de Monte Alto, Santo Antônio de Leverger=Santo Antônio do Leverger). All municipalities in the data matched; each shape is used by one code only.
